issue.title: CLI percent-listen capture tests never invoke the fake listen runner
issue.description:
## CI failure

Two `tests/cli` capture tests fail deterministically on master in this workspace:

- `capture::r#ref::percent_listen_reference_runs_existing_worker_and_installs_audio`
  panics at `tests/cli/capture/ref.rs:942` — `read listen invocation: Os { code: 2, kind: NotFound }`
  (the fake listen runner never wrote `$FAKE_LISTEN_LOG`).
- `capture::r#ref::failed_percent_listen_worker_keeps_listen_retry_guidance`
  panics at `tests/cli/capture/ref.rs:991` — `listen runner was invoked` (listen.log absent).

In both, `bob ref jobs run` exits successfully but the `BOB_HIGHLIGHTS_LISTEN_COMMAND`
fake runner is never invoked. A single-test rerun finishes in ~0.05 s, so the job run
appears to skip the listen step (or find no queued job) rather than time out.

Reproduction: `cargo test --test cli percent_listen_reference_runs_existing_worker -- --nocapture`
at master f9324da (also identically at 0d014c0, 7f14f5f, d513f01 per the Daily Stats
engine phase workers). The tests arrived with b0795ac (feat(capture): prioritize percent
URL listen intent) / ab9fbaf (listen command contract). Root cause is not yet known.

Proposed by bob-cli-6l.2.1 phases (bob-cli-6l.2.1.1 note #1, .3 note #1, .5 note #1,
.6 note #1) as an unrelated pre-existing failure; triaged by the bob-cli-6l.2.1 land agent.
Distinct from bob-cli-5l (lib-test ETXTBSY) and bob-cli-6j (Mac ffmpeg).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Fails identically on every run and on clean archives of d513f01, 7f14f5f, 0d014c0, and f9324da (four independent phase workers plus this land agent's just check and single-test rerun); the fake runner's log file is never created.

issue.creation_reason: Four Daily Stats engine phase workers independently hit the same two deterministic tests/cli failures on a clean base; no task bead tracked them, and they keep just check red for every agent.
